sentences.japanese: 韓国料理は一般的に辛い。
sentences.english: Korean food is generally very spicy.

sentences.japanese: 寒い朝は起きるのが辛い。
sentences.english: It is difficult to wake up on cold mornings.

sentences.japanese: 開拓者達は辛い生活をしたし、彼等の子供もそうだった。
sentences.english: Pioneer men and women had a hard life, and so did their children.

sentences.japanese: 我々は辛うじて困らないというだけだ。
sentences.english: We have just enough to live.

sentences.japanese: 一家は戦後ひどく辛い目にあった。
sentences.english: The family had a hard time after the war.
